findings.description: All four required cases are present with case-specific assertions, both added EXIT traps carry every path from the trap before them plus this task's own scratch paths, and the suite fails against the pre-fix lint naming the new v1-broken case.
findings.evidence:
CASE 1 (broken v1 link reported as link-broken) — tests/inbox-to-memory-smoke.sh:1256 requires the exact string "FAIL $v1_broken_note: link-broken: `this-target-does-not-exist-AAAAAAAAAA` resolves neither by name nor by id `AAAAAAAAAA`", with :1257 requiring "failures: 1". Injected above the fence at :1252-1253, which extract_body respects.
CASE 2 (v1 link resolving by filename not reported) — :1287 refutes "link-broken: `one-vendor-per-region-G2k65qG3Nc`"; that filename exists in the scope (tests/fixtures/inbox-to-memory/old-only/_memory/decisions/one-vendor-per-region-G2k65qG3Nc.md).
CASE 3 (v1 link resolving only by the trailing ten-character id not reported) — :1288 refutes "link-broken: `was-renamed-away-G2k65qG3Nc`". Non-vacuous, re-derived: `find tests/fixtures/inbox-to-memory/old-only -name '*was-renamed-away*' | wc -l` returns 0, so no filename can resolve it, and running the shipped lint on a scratch copy carrying both `[[was-renamed-away-G2k65qG3Nc]]` and `[[was-renamed-away-ZZZZZZZZZZ]]` printed exactly one line — "FAIL .../2025-11-04-atlas-scoping-call-3iMu15QJ_x.md: link-broken: `was-renamed-away-ZZZZZZZZZZ` resolves neither by name nor by id `ZZZZZZZZZZ`" / "failures: 1" — so only the shared id G2k65qG3Nc (10 chars) silences the first, via lint-scope.sh:376-377.
CASE 4 (six-way body injection still passes) — body at :1276-1283 carries all six items the clause names: `[invented token: x]`, `[open question resolved: opened-by-nobody]`, `[tension: bogus-state]`, `[contradicts accepted: nothing]`, `[decision: sideways]`, and `(raw: line 12)`. Asserted by :1286 require_line "failures: 0" plus six named refutes at :1289-1294 ("token-grammar", "open-question-fields", "tension-fields", "contradiction-fields", "decision-fields", "anchor-form"). All six labels exist verbatim in the lint (lint-scope.sh:229, :279, :293, :330, :345, :359). Non-vacuous, re-derived: a scratch copy of lint-scope.sh with the six checks added to T-001's v1 loop reported `1 token-grammar, 3 open-question-fields, 1 tension-fields, 1 contradiction-fields, 2 decision-fields, 2 anchor-form` and zero link-broken on that same body, so every refute has something real to refute.
TRAP WALK — baseline trap at :1203 lists 16 paths ($not_a_scope $inline_scope $dismissal_scope $mig $jrn $t2_extract_scope $t2x_dir $subset_scope $batched_scope $lifecycle_scope $idem_dir $v_pass $scripts_copy $v_combo $v_linkdrop $v_lintdefect). Added trap 1 at :1249 repeats all 16 verbatim in order and appends $v1_broken_scope (17). Added trap 2 at :1272 repeats all 17 verbatim in order and appends $v1_pass_scope (18). This task creates exactly two scratch paths, the mktemp -d at :1248 and :1271, and the final added trap carries both. The pre-existing gaps ($overrun_scope from :196, $tpl_scope from :346) are untouched, as the non-goals require.
